statement: theorem source_eq4_4 (V : Domain (E := E)) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hconvex : ∀ t < T, IsConvexExtended (loss t)) (hloss : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (hlegal : LegalFeedback V 1 D loss x₁ p T) (hdiam : ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, ∀ y ∈ V.carrier, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V 1 D loss x₁ p u T ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * D * Real.sqrt (energy V 1 D loss x₁ p T)
